scope: Editorial and procedural precision of the whole-project skill; no application-model changes

decision.rationale: Document/package acceptance checks passed. This does not assess application release readiness or native-client behavior.

acceptance.criterion: Define requirement levels, procedural terms, mandatory requirement IDs and phase exit evidence
acceptance.evidence: Primary SKILL.md editorial inspection and structural tests for requirement/phase IDs and defined terms

acceptance.criterion: Separate implementation, verification and release decisions consistently across the primary procedure, delivery guide and templates
acceptance.evidence: Cross-document inspection; template decision defaults and criterion/check ID references verified by test:skills

acceptance.criterion: Specify gate applicability, scoped stop conditions, evidence records and numerical comparison semantics
acceptance.evidence: Delivery and verification guide inspection; no scientific tolerance values or standards-conformity claims introduced

acceptance.criterion: Preserve portable discovery, resource links and synchronization for both clients
acceptance.evidence: skills:check and test:skills passed for four bundles and thirteen source files, including negative resource/drift tests

reviews: Terminology and contract review, followed by cross-document comparison of status fields, requirements and template references
Safety and evidence review, followed by inspection of gate/WARN/non-applicability and numerical-comparator rules; no external field or licensed-standard validation performed
Packaging review, followed by synchronization, resource/link/command tests and accepted-audit regression execution
notRun: Native Codex/Claude Code invocation and behavioral evaluations
Full application build/coverage/browser suites: not rerun for this document/template/test revision
limitations: Structural tests do not prove semantic completeness, professional quality or correct future agent decisions
Existing application numerical-reference and runtime release blockers are unchanged
rollback: Restore the prior canonical bundle/templates and matching test expectations, then regenerate both client discovery copies and run test:skills; no application-data migration
